body.name: rho
body.construction: Determine \(\rho_n(d,\kappa,\alpha,\beta,\gamma,L)\) by jointly optimizing annular contrast bias, rare-treatment local mass, projection approximation of the two unequal-smoothness nuisances, every nondegenerate and degenerate correction variance, and Gram-stabilization error; retain harmonic annular sums on equality surfaces.
